title: An Empirical Testbed for Theoretical ELK: Grounding Five Core Proposals

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Creates the infrastructure needed to empirically compare ELK proposals, one of the most important open problems in alignment. A unified testbed enables systematic evaluation and would be widely used by the ELK research community.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a unified testbed requires: training a model to hold secret beliefs, implementing five different probing strategies, and running comparable evaluations. Each probing strategy has its own implementation complexity. This is a substantial engineering project beyond beginner scope.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five ELK proposals implemented and compared, plus a reusable benchmark. Even implementing one ELK proposal correctly is a full 30-hour project. Five proposals with a benchmark framework is a multi-month effort.
